Event

Twilight Wishes

Tue, Nov 24, 2026, 10:00 AM → Mon, Nov 30, 2026, 8:00 PM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

The last event of the Twilight Trails season (Nov 24–30): Sun Scarf Espeon, Moon Scarf Umbreon and the Sun and Moon Crown Pikachu return, with better odds for Shiny Staryu and Shiny Elgyem.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

When

  • Tuesday, Nov 24, 10 a.m. to Monday, Nov 30, 8 p.m. local time.

Bonuses

  • 2× Stardust for catching Pokémon (3× with GO Pass Deluxe).
  • Higher chance of Shiny Staryu and Shiny Elgyem.

Raids and research

  • Event-themed Pokémon in one-star, three-star and Mega Raids.
  • Event Field Research features Pokémon from across the Twilight Trails season, changing partway through the week.

GO Pass: Twilight Wishes

  • Given to every Trainer free on Nov 24 at 10 a.m. local time.
  • GO Pass Deluxe (US$4.99) adds more rewards, including an event avatar pose, Star Pieces and Premium Battle Passes.

Tip

Pop a Star Piece while catching during the event: it stacks with the 2× Stardust bonus, a good week to stock up before the next season.

Written by Trainer Desk from the official announcement, checked November 9, 2026. Details can change, so check in game. See all upcoming GO events or the live event tracker for raid bosses and counters.
